holder-quote: They failed to take the caravan, though they had numbers on their side. For two reasons. One was Pisces. The other was Merr.
effect-quote: The unprepared freed [Slaves] felt the two Skills hit them as Merr ripped a sword from her sheath and charged the nearest Goblin. Qshom, shouting as a Goblin tried to swarm up the wagon, felt everything move a bit slower and kicked the Goblin off.
